messages:
elaine: Heads-up — onboarding smoke failed: embeddings.rerank.batch (async) returns inconsistent shapes across runs. Some runs return nested floats, others return nested dicts with metadata.

elaine: Small repro from sample-app async flow:
```python
resp = await client.embeddings.rerank.batch(queries=["who wrote this"], docs=[["doc1", "doc2"]])
# sometimes -> [[0.94, 0.05]]
# sometimes -> [[{"id": "doc1", "score": 0.94}, {"id": "doc2", "score": 0.05}]]
```

rahul: Which wheel/commit? This looks like the retry/auth refresh path re-parses server responses but skips the normalizer. We saw the same pattern in the generic batcher.

elaine: Wheel built from main earlier today. Correlates with token refresh logs (401->refresh->replay). Sync client always returns floats, async flips shape.

cho: Quick mitigation — add a tiny helper in examples called rerank_normalize(rows) so sample-apps coerce both shapes to scores until SDK patch lands. Example:```python
def rerank_normalize(rows):
    return [[item.get("score") if isinstance(item, dict) else item for item in row] for row in rows]
```

cho: Long-term fix: canonicalize at the public client boundary (both sync+async) so callers always get List[List[float]] by default. Add include_metadata: bool = False param to opt into dicts. Update typing stubs to reflect Union until include_metadata is typed properly.

rahul: Sounds good. Add unit tests for sync+async+retry, a mypy check for stubs, and a CHANGELOG note under "Bugfix (python)" so support can reference it. Also backport to 0.9.x branch.

elaine: Will update onboarding tests to use the helper for now. Please tag me on the PR.

dev-bot: Issue created: #4102 — "python sdk: embeddings.rerank.batch inconsistent response schema on retry". CI job triggered.

sdk-bot: PR template linked in #4102. Assigning to @cho for the patch.
